title: Gateway Theatre

services.name: Theatre Rental
services.desc: On July 1, 2017, 42nd Street Moon took over management of the Eureka Theatre, its home for the past 15 years. Per the lease agreement, the name has been changed to the Gateway Theatre. We are currently making cosmetic improvements to enhance the customer experience, including painting the lobby and auditorium and replacing the seating. We have also made some improvements to the lighting and sound systems. 42nd Street Moon is working with the Golden Gateway Partners on a long-term (minimum 10 year) lease to ensure the arts remain a vibrant and vital presence in the neighborhood.
